author: MauriSterling
quote: I’m around 40 hours played and this is the most incredible open world created, all the situations, the weather, the vehicles, the relation between the main characters, if we want to play a perfect game this is the real option, and after all the polishing coming in the next months I can’t imagine how this game is going to look for PC, 13 years of magic.

author: MauriSterling
quote: Only Nintendo can take a masterpiece, make new graphics and release with any upgrade or change, 80$ for the same game in horrible.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
